purpose: Contract 9.1 golden fixture: real Overpass responses for representative beaches, captured while the Overpass path still runs, with the derived records/signals the pure functions produced from them. Temporary shadow-period scaffolding.
howCaptured: Each case ran the three real production Overpass queries for its bbox (buildQuery, the private buildParkBeachQuery, and buildPondWaterQuery when pondWaterSeeds returned seeds) against the live public mirrors, then recorded the raw elements alongside the records the pure functions derived from them: parseParkBeachElements output, the seed list, the water evidence, and the kept/dropped beaches with their associated park. The waterClass entries ran buildWaterClassQuery per beach and recorded parseWaterClassElements signals plus the classifyWaterBody verdict.
lifecycle: TEMPORARY shadow-period scaffolding for the prebuilt-layer (FlatGeobuf) migration. Captured BEFORE any deletion, per contract 9.1, because it is the only mechanical proof that the Overpass-derived and layer-derived records agree. Deleted together with its replay/parity test once the migration delete path is armed and clean.
